need: An interval on each configuration's overall pass rate (measure_read with statistics ci/half_width/n returns only the mean; the snapshot holds no readings or contrasts)
why: The pick clears the pass-rate gate by a tenth of a point; without an interval the page cannot say whether that clearance is borderline or settled
workaround: Treat the clearance as borderline in words: a flag, an open caveat and the first Watch item; no interval is shown or typed

need: settle: how many fresh cases a re-test of the pick needs to separate its pass rate from the gate
why: The first next step is a re-test, and it should name its size
workaround: The next step names the re-test without a case count

need: A selection-adjusted reading for the best of many configurations near one gate
why: The pick is the one of eighteen that happened to clear the gate; its estimate is optimistic and nothing quantifies how much
workaround: Said in words in the confidence caveat and Watch; the re-test is specified on fresh cases

need: Price gated fallbacks against the survivor (price_tradeoff prices survivors only, and arm_filter on the survivor returns an empty against list)
why: If the pick fails its re-test the decider needs what each fallback costs, which is a gate relaxation priced in money
workaround: A cost bars block over the survivor and the configurations that clear the pass-rate gate, plus cost_per_month keys in prose

need: Figure keys for factor effects in a factorial sweep: what one retry, or a step of reasoning, adds within each model (no control, so measure_breakdown and arm_minus_control refuse)
why: Retry against reasoning is the design's main finding; it can only be read off adjacent lattice tiles
workaround: The lattice block carries the figures; the claim states the direction in words with no number

need: Task case counts or a declared traffic mix (measure_read by task reports n_cases none)
why: The gate is on the overall rate, and the pick is below the gate on two tasks; whether the eval's case mix matches production decides whether the overall figure is the right one to gate (confound_check is not available either)
workaround: Carried as an open caveat with its material_if and a declaration in next steps

need: A cost unit that matches the campaign: cost_per_1k's usd_per_1k filter and block cells print 'per 1,000 replies' while the measure is named 'Cost per 1k calls' for planner queries
why: The page would call a planner query a reply
workaround: Prose cites monthly cost (cost_per_month) at the declared volume; the cost bars caption names the unit

need: Reader names on every point of gate_scatter (only the emphasized point gets its name; the rest print raw arm ids)
why: Writing rules forbid ids above the appendix, and the scatter is the lead block
workaround: Kept the scatter for its two-gate view; the lattice beside it names every configuration

need: A way to resolve a figure-keyed prose string before submit
why: No action checks that every key in the draft resolves and prints as intended
workaround: Resolved the keys through a block_render title, which accepts figure keys

need: What makes a trial pass, and caveat ids for analyst-raised caveats (caveats_list is empty, yet the pick's gate rests on a point estimate)
why: Method must say what pass means, and confidence.caveats needs ids that land
workaround: Method says pass is not defined in the snapshot and names the failure kinds the examples record; caveat ids are the analyst's own

need: Cost per query from a per-call cost measure: cost_per_1k times calls_per_task, and cost_per_month on that basis
why: The cost measure is named per 1k calls, the volume carries no unit, and cost_per_month multiplies them as if both counted queries; the editor flagged a possible understatement by the calls per task
workaround: Method states the basis question and cites the pick's calls per task; the order of the gate passers was checked by hand on both bases, so no derived figure is typed

need: gate_scatter point labels that stay reader names when every configuration is drawn (names print for a six-arm filter, ids for all eighteen)
why: The lead two-gate view could not show the whole sweep without internal ids above the appendix
workaround: The lattice carries all configurations by name; the scatter is filtered to the Brisk-S row, which holds the corner, and the full scatter is in omitted

need: An interval on p95 latency, and a production-load latency reading beside the harness figure
why: The pick's latency headroom is one harness p95 with no interval; whether it survives production load can't be read
workaround: Carried as an open caveat with its material_if, and a next step to measure p95 under load

need: More than one frozen failure per arm and query type (the examples pool holds at most one per aspect, arm and stratum)
why: The multi-hop directive in next steps rests on whether the collapsed-chain failure is a pattern, and one card can't show that
workaround: The next step first reads a sample of the pick's multi-hop failures; the claim says the pattern rests on one frozen failure
